Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for a razor clam license.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to personal use licenses for shellfish harvest; andamending RCW 77.32.520.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.32.520 and 2000 c 107 s 27 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A personal use shellfish and seaweed license is required forall persons other than residents or nonresidents under fifteen years ofage to fish for, take, dig for, or possess seaweed or shellfish,including razor clams, for personal use from state waters or offshorewaters including national park beaches. (2) A razor clam license allows a person to harvest only razorclams for three consecutive days for personal use from state waters oroffshore waters, including national park beaches. (3) The fees for annual personal use shellfish and seaweed licensesare: (a) For a resident fifteen years of age or older, seven dollars; (b) For a nonresident fifteen years of age or older, twentydollars; and (c) For a senior, five dollars. p. 1 HB 2621 (((3) The license fee for a twoday personal use shellfish andseaweed license is six dollars for residents or nonresidents fifteenyears of age or older.)) (4) The fee for a razor clam license is seven dollars for residentsand fourteen dollars for nonresidents. (5) A personal use shellfish and seaweed license ((shall)) or razorclam license must be visible on the licensee while harvesting shellfishor seaweed.
